description: The competing/repeated-operation and failure-mode test suite that proves the graded invariants hold under concurrency -- made DETERMINISTIC via the SerialExecutor's FIFO ordering (submit multiple app.inject requests, then await Promise.all), NEVER via timing/sleeps. This is what separates the submission from a happy-path-only one, and it includes the design-review Finding-1 report-under-concurrency reconciliation test. Depends on FEAT-002 (needs the full working service). Grounded in design.md Sections 4.2, 13, 14 and design-review Finding 1.
steps: Create c:\...\be\test\concurrency.test.ts with a fresh buildApp per test, all carts created via POST /carts and their returned ids captured: (a) OVERSELL -- two carts each qty 2 of p_limited (stock 3); fire both checkouts WITHOUT awaiting the first (const p1=app.inject(...); const p2=app.inject(...); await Promise.all([p1,p2])); assert exactly one 201 and one 409 INSUFFICIENT_INVENTORY, final p_limited inventory exactly 1 and never negative. (b) COUPON RACE -- generate one single-use coupon, two carts, both checkouts supply that coupon, fire via Promise.all; assert exactly one 201 and one 409 COUPON_NOT_REDEEMABLE, and GET /admin/coupons shows the coupon redeemed exactly once. (c) COUPON SURVIVES FAILURE -- generate a coupon, create a cart whose p_limited qty exceeds stock, checkout with the coupon; assert 409 INSUFFICIENT_INVENTORY AND the coupon is back to available.

Create c:\...\be\test\report-concurrency.test.ts (design-review Finding 1): fire GET /admin/report concurrently with a committing checkout using the same Promise.all pattern as the oversell test; assert all reconciliation identities still hold on the report snapshot: netRevenueCents === grossRevenueCents - totalDiscountsCents; coupons.generated === available + reserved + redeemed; coupons.redeemed === count(orders with couponCode != null); coupons.generated <= milestonesReached. This exercises R-REPORT-SYNC rather than assuming it.
Optionally add a money/no-float determinism assertion within the suite (discount never makes total negative) if not already covered by test/money.test.ts.
Run the FULL suite and confirm green; fix any seams exposed between modules.
acceptance_criteria: The oversell test asserts counts (one 201, one 409) and final inventory, not which specific cart wins; no setTimeout/sleep anywhere -- determinism is from executor FIFO.
verification: Run `npx vitest run test/concurrency.test.ts test/report-concurrency.test.ts` -- all green.
Run `npm test` -- the entire suite passes in a single non-watch pass.
findings:
COMPLETED. Added test/concurrency.test.ts (3 tests) and test/report-concurrency.test.ts (1 test); `npx vitest run test/concurrency.test.ts test/report-concurrency.test.ts` = 4 green, full `npm test` = 49 green across 9 files, `npm run build` (strict tsc) exits 0. No cross-module seams needed fixing — FEAT-002's service already exposed everything the tests need.

Determinism is from SerialExecutor FIFO ONLY: competing mutations are submitted via app.inject WITHOUT awaiting the first, then resolved with Promise.all. NO setTimeout/sleeps anywhere. Carts are created via POST /carts and their returned randomUUID ids captured; assertions are on counts + final inventory, never on which cart wins.

concurrency.test.ts: (a) OVERSELL — two carts qty 2 each of p_limited (stock 3), raced -> statuses sort to [201,409], failing is INSUFFICIENT_INVENTORY, final p_limited inventory exactly 1 and >= 0, report.ordersPlaced === 1. (b) COUPON RACE — one single-use coupon on two carts raced -> [201,409], failing is COUPON_NOT_REDEEMABLE, GET /admin/coupons shows exactly one redeemed entry for the code AND report.coupons.redeemed === 1. (c) COUPON SURVIVES FAILURE — coupon + cart with p_limited qty 5 (> stock) -> 409 INSUFFICIENT_INVENTORY, coupon back to 'available', report.coupons.available === 1 / redeemed === 0.

report-concurrency.test.ts (Finding 1): seeds n plain orders + a milestone coupon redeemed on a discounted order, then fires GET /admin/report concurrently with a committing checkout via Promise.all. All reconciliation identities asserted on the raced snapshot and again on the settled report: netRevenueCents === grossRevenueCents - totalDiscountsCents; coupons.generated === available + reserved + redeemed; coupons.generated <= milestonesReached; coupons.redeemed === count(orders with a couponCode) (=== 1). Final report shows ordersPlaced === n+2.

BEHAVIOR FEAT-004 DOCS SHOULD REFLECT: concurrency determinism is a design property of the SerialExecutor FIFO queue, not timing — document that competing requests are submitted together (Promise.all) with no sleeps. GET /admin/report returns the report body UNWRAPPED (not {report}); GET /admin/coupons returns a BARE array of {code,percentOff,milestone,status}. The coupon-survival invariant is observable: a failed checkout (INSUFFICIENT_INVENTORY) releases a reserved coupon back to 'available'. Money determinism (discount never makes total negative) stays covered by test/money.test.ts, so step 3 was not duplicated here.
